blocks.title: Client–server
blocks.text: Many clients request services from a managed central server.

blocks.title: Worked example · Access control + backup
blocks.text: Client–server suits managed central data, controlled permissions, auditing and backups. A server failure can affect many clients, so redundancy and resilient backups matter. Peer-to-peer file sharing is harder to manage consistently.

blocks.title: Verify authentic file
blocks.text: A P2P distribution model can share upload load among peers, reducing demand on one central server. Clients must verify file authenticity with trusted signatures/hashes; peers may be untrusted or offline.
